name: Document top
description: The beginning of the document page: header, title, one or two sentences of introduction, key facts and action buttons. On the right side are abstract illustrations selected by topic.
scenarios: The first section of each document page explains what this page can help the reader accomplish.
Provide key facts such as prerequisites, time, and next steps at the top of the page.

boundaries: Only used at the beginning of document pages, one per page; not used for section headings in the main text.
Illustrations are six fixed abstract themes, and images cannot be passed in; when screenshots are needed, use image components in the text.

usage.purpose: Let readers know on the first screen what task this page solves, what prerequisites are required, and where to go next.
structure: Left side: header, title (28px), introduction, action button; right side: 220×150 abstract illustration; bottom side: a line of key facts separated by thin lines.
Single column below 640px, with the illustration scaled down and placed above the title.

inputs.meaning: The short label above the title, usually the column.
The title of the page is written as what the reader wants to accomplish. It is recommended not to exceed 20 Chinese characters.
One or two sentences of introduction, no more than 80 Chinese characters recommended. Inline tags: **bold**,`代码`, [text] (link); links can be written ashttps://…or doc:slug#anchor.
Key facts, up to 4 groups, such as need, when, for whom.
A set of facts: labels in small print at the top, numerical values ​​at the bottom.
For factual content, it is recommended not to exceed 14 Chinese characters; inline markup is available.
Button text is recommended to be no more than 8 Chinese characters.
Link address:https://…or doc:slug#anchor (convert to document site address and open in the site).
When true, a solid main button is displayed; it is recommended that only one be set at the top of each page.

Illustration themes: start stacked pages, concepts nodes and connections, workbench workbench window, agent dialogue turned into pages, collab multi-terminal synchronization, dev code and components; none does not display illustrations, and the text fills the width.

recipes.title: write a header
steps: Use one sentence to describe what the page wants the reader to accomplish as a title.
The introduction supplements the scope and results without repeating the title.
facts Only include facts that readers need to know before starting.
actions point to the most common next steps.

interactions.effect: Open the link; the document link opens within the site.

constraints: Read-only display, page data will not be modified.
When there are more than 4 facts and 3 actions, the redundant items will not be displayed (the schema will also reject them).

data: Modify text, facts, buttons and illustration themes.
implementation: To add a new illustration theme, you need to add drawing functions to ARTS and expand the schema's art enumeration, and release a new version.

entryPoints.purpose: Components, six illustrations, md() inline tags and readData.
Tokens, layout, illustration color and narrow screen rules.

architecture: The illustrations are code-drawn SVGs, and the colors are all from CSS token classes (p/l/k/f-*/s-*/c-*), switching with light and dark themes.
md() converts inline tags into React elements without injecting HTML; doc: links are converted into site addresses.
extensionPoints: ARTS maps illustration themes to drawing functions.
invariants: The component does not call onChange.
The link is a normal <a href>, which is intercepted and opened by the host.
verification: Check out the six illustrations and fact rows at 1000px, 390px width, and light and dark themes.
The focus box is visible when keyboard Tab to the button.

defaultData.title: Create your first shareable page in ten minutes
defaultData.lead: Start the local workbench, create a new project and page, use `/`to insert charts and components, and finally export an HTML that can be opened offline.

data.title: Create your first shareable page in ten minutes
data.lead: Start the local workbench, create a new project and page, use `/`to insert charts and components, and finally export an HTML that can be opened offline.

data.title: Let Agent directly write editable pages
data.lead: Install the ShowAI plug-in in Codex or Claude Code, and the Agent reads and writes the same content library through MCP; what you see in the workbench is the page it just saved.

data.title: CLI & MCP Reference
data.lead: All commands read and write the same content library and exit after execution; they can also be used when the workbench is closed.
